findings.conclusion: Independent XML bibliography extraction confirms CR49 and CR50 print the same uppercase ASTM DOI but name different works. Neither contains a typed DOI pub-id; CR50 ext-link href contains the entire bibliographic string. Preserve those source literals and do not follow or repair the malformed href automatically.

Retained Crossref metadata has the Gussev chapter title and five author surnames in the same order as CR49, while its 2014 date fields and pages 1-19 differ from the citation's 2015 and 31-49. That supports core bibliographic agreement only. It conflicts with CR50 author/title/year and cannot serve as a unique key joining both references.

A separately scoped single query returned three records. Two share the Klueh title, 1985, volume 2 and 407-416 pages; one also matches issue 3 and the expanded Nuclear Engineering and Design. Fusion container. The second has a different container and no issue in returned selected fields. The third has a different JOM title. The report correctly keeps two candidate DOI nodes without alias, correction, duplicate-publication or distinct-measurement-source inference.

Independent Table 2 citation-only extraction matches all parent cells. CR5 to CR60 and CR69 to CR70 occur in distinct Data Source/Dataset columns; CR74 points to literal 75–86 with explicit XML endpoints CR75 and CR86. The range remains unexpanded. Experimental data labels contain no specimen/test/heat identity. These are documentary edges, not verified overlap, measurement joins or independent-unit counts.

Each frozen scope predates its corresponding recorded GET; URLs/final URLs, HTTP 200 statuses, byte counts and hashes agree with exact retained bodies. Candidate scope references the prior exact response. The initial author projection is retained; only author fields were narrowed to given/family/sequence, with prior public affiliation/role exposure explicitly acknowledged.

The original paraphrase/bibliographic-fact report attributes the Li article, retains its distinct CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 scope, and does not transfer registry metadata availability into full-text access rights. No actual archive References worksheet join, sample lineage, overlap or independence is established. G20 unresolved, G21 blocked and prior scientific NO-GO results are not displaced.
